text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's dancing!! Come on, join in!! ――More 
dynamically, open up those joints!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Pump up the beat even more!! 
...See? Your heart's getting all fired up 
along with it, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Doing nothing just because you're tired is 
the absolute worst. 'When feeling down, 
dance; when feeling lost, dive.' Keep that 
in mind...!
